meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把不同标准的基因位置统一起来，避免分析出错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常处理基因数据，总被不同位置标注弄晕。
copy.tagline_en: Unify genomic coordinates between different formats to avoid mismatches.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic position data and often get confused by coordinate differences.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用脚本在 BED、GFF/GTF、VCF、SAM/BAM 等格式之间换算坐标，把同一变异的不同写法归一化并比对，还会在连接数据前检查基因组版本与染色体命名是否一致。
howto.when: 当坐标跨格式、跨工具或跨基因组版本时触发，例如提到“off by one”“0-based”“liftover”等关键词，或要求换算区间、规范化变异、审查坐标写法时。

say.text: 把 chr1:999-1000 从 BED 转成 GFF 坐标
say.note: 输出转换表，含长度与状态

say.text: 用 ref.fa 规范化 chr1:7:CAC:C 并左对齐
say.note: 返回归一化写法与 REF 检查结果

say.text: 检查 variants.vcf 和 annotation.gtf 能否直接连接
say.note: 报告命名、长度、版本是否冲突

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude converts intervals between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM and other formats, normalises and compares variant representations, and checks assembly and contig naming before a join.
howto.when_en: Triggers when coordinates cross a format, tool or assembly boundary - mentions of "off by one", "0-based", "liftover", or requests to convert intervals, normalise variants, or find a wrong base.

say_en.text: Convert chr1:999-1000 from BED to GFF coordinates
say_en.note: Prints the conversion table with length and status

say_en.text: Normalise and left-align chr1:7:CAC:C against ref.fa
say_en.note: Returns the normalised form and REF check

say_en.text: Check whether variants.vcf and annotation.gtf can be joined
say_en.note: Reports naming, length and build conflicts
